candidates.title: Elbows up or down? Why Alberta is diplomacy-first in the trade war
candidates.description: Nathan Cooper, Alberta’s senior representative to the United States, told CBC’s West of Centre that compared to provinces that have taken a more aggressive approach, Alberta has come out ahead.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'We really weren't prepared for that': Torrential rain batters Cape Breton
candidates.description: Richmond County Warden Lois Landry says the rainfall over the weekend caught them unprepared. A fatality in Richmond County may be related to flooding.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 46-year-old Cape Breton woman found dead in flooded area
candidates.description: In a news release issued Sunday, RCMP said the woman's vehicle was parked near her residence in Cleveland, N.S., on the far side of a flooded bridge. First responders carried out a search Saturday and found the body in the area around 2:30 p.m. AT.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'It looked like a puddle': Tow truck driver kept busy by huge N.S. rainfall
candidates.description: Weekends are usually quiet for Tyson McEwan of McEwans Towing, but he has already recovered about 20 vehicles so far this weekend. The Havre Boucher, N.S., business is based in Antigonish County near the Canso Causeway.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Sept. 11 was one of many times N.L. residents have opened their homes in a crisis
candidates.description: Newfoundlanders and Labradorians have a long-history of helping those in need, even before the generosity displayed nearly 25 years ago when people opened their homes to stranded airline passengers during 9/11.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: State of emergency declared in 3 Cape Breton counties after storm, flooding
candidates.description: A deluge exceeding 200 millimetres of rain has left some Nova Scotians dealing with power outages and isolating Cape Breton communities with washed-out roads.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Why is Windsor using giant foam blocks to build the approach to a new overpass?
candidates.description: You’ve probably seen them because they’re hard to miss–hundreds of large, white building blocks stacked several feet high near the new overpass project by Banwell Road and E.C. Row Expressway Interchange.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: City orders Live Nation Canada to repair Rogers Stadium after 'significant damage'
candidates.description: The City of Toronto has issued an "order to remedy unsafe building" to Live Nation Canada about the state of Rogers Stadium after the concert venue was damaged by Wednesday's severe thunderstorm.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Snowbirds take their final flight over Toronto until the 2030s at this weekend’s air show
candidates.description: The 77th Canadian International Air Show is roaring back into the city this Labour Day weekend, with high-flying demonstrations at Toronto’s lakeshore.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alberta independence group releases its ‘transition plan’ to become a country
candidates.description: An independence group has released a “transition plan,” sketching out what it sees as a roadmap should Albertans vote in the future to become a sovereign nation. Meanwhile, a federalist leader says the plan is akin to showing up for dinner after a divorce.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How public institutions — like schools and transit — are handling Quebec's new secularism law
candidates.description: From university halls to Metro garages, public institutions across Quebec are quietly locking prayer rooms and rewriting employee guidelines as the province’s expanded secularism law takes full effect.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: AI-powered surveillance cameras are spreading in Canada
candidates.description: Automatic licence plate recognition cameras are in the spotlight as citizens across North America question their use by municipalities and law enforcement agencies — with some critics calling them a tool for ‘mass surveillance.’ One company in particular, Flock Safety, has found itself at the heart of the debate and while the company’s tech has yet to be used in Canada, greater awareness about these AI-powered cameras is raising questions about how Canadian ALPR camera makers operate.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Hamilton NHL prospect Matthew Mayich 'needs a miracle' after training collapse, family lawyer says
candidates.description: Hamilton-born NHL prospect Matthew Mayich 'needs a miracle' in hospital after he collapsed during a 'brutal' workout at Arizona State University last month, according to his family's lawyer. Rob Carey is calling for the university to investigate the incident.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 1 person dead, another in custody after shooting in remote First Nation in northwestern Ontario
candidates.description: One person is dead and another is in police custody following a shooting in North Spirit Lake First Nation, a remote Oji-Cree community in northwestern Ontario. Here's what we know about the incident.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Man charged with arson after cars torched outside Liberal MP's home: police
candidates.description: Toronto police say they have arrested and charged a man in connection to an arson investigation after several cars were torched at the home of a Scarborough MP last week.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold talks in Ukraine after meeting with Putin
candidates.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held "encouraging" talks in Kyiv on Sunday in their first official visit to Ukraine as part of a renewed push to end more than 4½ years of Russia's full-scale invasion.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Indonesia's Anak Krakatau volcano erupts, cancelling flights at Jakarta airport and others
candidates.description: Anak Krakatau volcano erupted in Indonesia early Sunday, prompting the cancellation of all flights at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport and disrupting other domestic airports as volcanic ash drifted across parts of western Indonesia.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Woman found alive in home destroyed by Nepal flood, days after family began mourning rites
candidates.description: Believing she had perished in Nepal's deadly floods, the family of Chandika Kumari Shrestha started the ritual of mourning the elderly woman's death.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Iran claims a strike on a U.S. ship in the Strait of Hormuz, which the U.S. denies
candidates.description: Iran said Sunday it struck an unmanned U.S. vessel trying to enter the Strait of Hormuz, a claim that the U.S. military dismissed as a "total lie."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Israeli strikes kill 4 in southern Lebanon
candidates.description: Israeli strikes killed four people, including two women, in southern Lebanon on Sunday, the Lebanese Health Ministry said, as Israel retaliated for what it said were Hezbollah drone attacks within areas occupied by its troops.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: A month after migrants surged into Ceuta, thousands of kids are still stranded on the streets
candidates.description: Ikram, 17, left the Moroccan border town of Fnideq at the end of July, when an estimated 80,000 Moroccans and migrants from countries further south travelled travelled to the northern border city, hoping to cross into Ceuta. For a brief period, Ikram felt relief in the Spanish enclave. But she is now homeless.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. ambassador visits Palestinian town amid rise in occupied West Bank settler violence
candidates.description: U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee on Saturday met with Palestinian Americans, including relatives of U.S. citizens killed by Israeli settlers, in a Palestinian town in the occupied West Bank that has been the target of settler attacks.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. military hits 3 Iranian oil tankers after saying its navy warships were targeted
candidates.description: U.S. forces struck three Iranian oil tankers after Navy warships were targeted with ballistic missiles, the American military said Saturday, warning that it would "if necessary, destroy Iran's limited and exposed oil fleet."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Rescuers in Nepal pull 2 people alive from the debris 10 days after devastating floods
candidates.description: Rescuers in Nepal pulled out a Chinese man and a woman in separate operations Saturday, 10 days after devastating floods hit the country, as teams continued searching for thousands of missing people.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Dozens hurt, at least 10 dead in explosion at Bolivian military barracks
candidates.description: At least 10 people were killed and dozens more injured on Friday after an explosion at ‌a military barracks in the Bolivian municipality of Viacha, about 30 kilometres from La Paz, local authorities said.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: IN PHOTOS | Best of World Nomad Games
candidates.description: The World Nomad Games, a cultural and sporting festival centred on traditional nomadic ‌sports, are happening in Kyrgyzstan until Sunday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Etsy seller's 'bruh' T-shirts were removed over a trademark complaint. He says it's trademark squatting
candidates.description: An Etsy seller says the online retailer removed his listings for T-shirts with the word "bruh" after the person who holds a Canadian trademark for it complained. One legal expert worries that the costly nature of trademark disputes makes it difficult to challenge such cases.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Counter-tariffs won't just affect the cost of goods for Canadians. They'll hit the trailers moving them too
candidates.description: Canadians bracing for billions of dollars in counter-tariffs won't just see prices rise on American items like produce, toilet paper and furniture, but on the very semi-trailers used to haul those goods.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: German far-right set for big win in eastern state - projections
candidates.description: Germany's AfD has hailed a "historic result" and is projected to win more than 44% of the vote, far ahead of the conservative CDU on 18.4%.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Volcano eruption leaves 170,000 passengers stranded in Indonesia
candidates.description: More than 170,000 airline passengers are stranded after ash was detected in airspace near Jakarta following the eruptions.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Dozens feared trapped in collapsed building in Delhi
candidates.description: As many as 50 people are thought to have been inside the five-storey hostel when it came down.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Iran warns of 'faster, heavier, more painful response' to US attacks
candidates.description: The comments came a day after Washington said it had struck Iranian oil tankers in response to Tehran's attacks on US warships in the region.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Prince William to attend King Harald's funeral in Norway
candidates.description: The Prince of Wales will represent the King at the funeral of Harald V in Oslo next week.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
candidates.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
candidates.description: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
candidates.description: Authorities fear the death toll in Viacha will rise and warn people to stay away from the barracks due to a risk of further explosions.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
candidates.description: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
candidates.description: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - with the US as the only nation to vote against it.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Tate brothers officially indicted with trafficking and sex crimes in Romania
candidates.description: Andrew and Tristan Tate are currently in a Miami jail fighting extradition to the UK over separate charges and deny all the allegations.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Majority Russian-speaking city in Ukraine considers language ban in the arts
candidates.description: Ukraine's third-biggest city Odesa decides this week whether to ban Russian-language content in music and literature in public.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Aviation faces hotter, stormier skies – and passengers might have to accept more disruption
candidates.description: Are people going to have to increasingly accept more delays and diversions as the effects of climate change intensify?
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What different world maps get right - and what they get wrong
candidates.description: As the UN adopts a new world map to reflect Africa's true size, let's take a closer look at what different maps get right and wrong.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial has divided US on whether she's victim or criminal
candidates.description: Some say the case shed light on the mental health struggles of mothers, while others argue it's no excuse for murder.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: How might Lindsay Clancy’s case have unfolded in another country?
candidates.description: The US mother was on trial for strangling her three children. In other western countries, there’s a specific law for mums who kill their young children.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: How the Lindsay Clancy trial gripped America - and ultimately fell apart
candidates.description: A Massachusetts judge has declared a mistrial in the murder case against the US mother after jurors were unable to reach a unanimous verdict.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Why did USS Lincoln turn up in Thailand looking so rusty?
candidates.description: When the USS Abraham Lincoln docked in Thailand this week some people were quick to criticise the condition it was in.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Ancient cave art discovery suggests first known humans in Ireland walked over from Wales
candidates.description: During the most recent Ice Age, researchers believe there was a "lost land bridge" between Wales and Ireland.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: German exit polls suggest far-right party has big lead in regional election
candidates.description: The Alternative for Germany party has a strong lead in a regional election, but it is unclear if it will be able to form Germany's's first far-right state government since WWII, exit polls indicate.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
candidates.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: U.S. strikes three Iranian oil tankers in renewal of hostilities
candidates.description: The U.S. strikes three Iranian oil tankers after Iran targets two American warships, in the latest exchange over shipping and the Strait of Hormuz.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: This is the work of our lifetime: Ayana Elizabeth Johnson urges action after new UN climate report
candidates.description: A United Nations report has found that the world will warm to 1.5 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels. Climate solutions advocate Ayana Elizabeth Johnson urges a quicker implementation of known strategies - and determination rather than despair.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: How the U.S. focus on Iran is fueling a more aggressive Putin
candidates.description: Trump's top envoys head to Moscow and Kyiv as Putin steps up round the clock bombing of Ukraine. With the U.S. distracted by Iran, is Putin becoming increasingly emboldened?
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal puts opposition in a political bind
candidates.description: Venezuelan opposition members are uneasy with new oil deals with the U.S., worried that agreements with authoritarian regime in Caracas could undermine democratic progress.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: U.S. envoys in Moscow in new push for peace between Russia and Ukraine
candidates.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow to revive efforts to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called for a halt to air attacks during their visit, but Moscow has not publicly responded.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte posts bail after arrest

candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: The U.N. backs a new world map showing Africa in its true relative size
candidates.description: The U.N. has backed a new map showing Africa in its true relative size, with the U.S. standing alone in opposition.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Trump issues new executive orders on beef sales to pacify American cattle ranchers
candidates.description: President Trump's latest executive orders allows ranchers to sell meat directly to consumers. Ranchers have been upset over Trump's plan to boost beef imports in a bid to lower prices.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Former State Department energy envoy on how the war in Iran is impacting gas prices
candidates.description: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to former State Department energy envoy David Goldwyn about how the war in Iran continues to affect gas and diesel prices.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
candidates.description: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Whatever happened to kindness? Spoiler alert: Our readers prove it's alive and well
candidates.description: We asked readers to share stories about a moment of kindness involving a stranger. Here are some of their heartwarming anecdotes.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Rewriting the narrative: One man's journey through the new era of lung cancer care
candidates.description: Lung cancer is still the top cancer killer. But new developments are shifting what the future might hold for patients, as one man's cancer journey shows.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Whatever happened to the floating schools of Bangladesh?
candidates.description: It was a light bulb moment: If monsoon rains keep kids from safely getting to school, let's create a floating school to pick them up! Bangladesh pioneered the idea. How's it doing?
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Do you hate being middle-aged? NPR's Allison Aubrey wants to change that
candidates.description: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with Allison Aubrey, health and science correspondent for NPR and the author of Your Turn: How to Create a Midlife You Love . You can share your story of midlife reinvention.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: 'The health system in Nepal is not prepared for this'
candidates.description: That's the grim assessment from the ground in the wake of the catastrophic flooding, which damaged or destroyed 7 health facilities, interrupted routine care and is affecting mental health.
